thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: spike in routing churn and repeated cross-region fallbacks detected. High 5xx rate + latency across EU/APAC. Affected service: smart-routing, policy engine.

maya: paging @li (oncall) 8:45 UTC. users reporting incorrect model outputs and timeouts. taking this.

li: i'm on it. first glance: router logs show oscillation: requests try eu-central -> ap-southeast -> eu-central in a loop. selected_variant sometimes 'm-proxy-legacy' which is deprecated.

opsbot: deploy-log: control-plane schema v4.0 promoted at 2026-03-16T08:30Z. Note: field rename `default_variant` -> `variant_default` and `fallback_regions` semantics changed to opt-in. Some org configs still contain `default_variant` and `fallback_regions: []` which should have been rejected. Validator accepted and set `enable_fallback`=true implicitly.

li: that matches. router snippet: `WARN: route_decision: tenant=org-314, intended_variant=pin: m-prod, resolved_variant=m-proxy-legacy, fallback_step=3, last_region=ap-southeast-1`

eng-rt: we also see the circuit breaker tripping between regions because kv-cache is cold per region and the router prefers lowest-cost variant when pin absent. This caused a small fraction of users to be routed to legacy quantized variant.

maya: mitigation: 1) set runtime emergency flag to honor explicit model pins (priority > policy fallback), 2) disable automatic region fallback globally until validator fixed, 3) selectively route affected tenants back to their pinned variants via per-tenant override.

li: applying emergency priority flag now.

li: command: ```
POST https://controlplane.internal/api/overrides
Body: {"emergency_variant_priority": true, "scope": "orgs:affected-*"}
```

opsbot: override applied (ov-11021). Telemetry: fallback_count dropping.

li: disabling region fallback: ```
PATCH /config/global
{"routing": {"allow_cross_region_fallback": false}}
```

opsbot: config updated. Warning: increased p50 latency for EU while caches warm.

cs-lead: CS: notifying top impacted customers (org-314, org-777, org-900). Preparing tailored messages. No PII detected in sample checks so far.

li: quick impact numbers (window 08:28Z-08:48Z): ran query on routing_logs:
```sql
SELECT org_id, count(*) AS misroutes
FROM routing_logs
WHERE resolved_variant = 'm-proxy-legacy' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-16T08:28:00Z' AND '2026-03-16T08:48:00Z'
GROUP BY org_id;
```

li: counts: org-314: 2,840; org-777: 1,210; org-900: 420; misc orgs ~1,350. Total ~5.8k requests.

maya: thanks. prioritize org-314 for direct outreach. Also need to confirm whether truncation or hallucination regressions occurred vs baseline for these requests.

eng-rt: quick diff on config-schema: v3.x allowed unknown fields and silently defaulted new semantics. v4.0 intended to be strict, but our migration script kept legacy-tolerant mode enabled for backward compat and that path had a bug that toggled fallback to true. Patch in-progress.

li: i'm going to roll back the validator to strict reject mode; also adding a hotfix that causes the control plane to reject updates containing `default_variant` key.

li: executing rollback: ```
POST /admin/validator/revert
{"to_version": "v3.9", "force": true}
```

opsbot: validator revert initiated.

maya: assign ownership: i'll run the incident timeline + customer impact analysis. li, handoff to srebot at 09:15Z.

srebot: reminder: scheduled oncall handoff at 09:15Z. Please ensure runbook notes and overrides are documented.

li: leaving runbook snippet: 1) confirm ov-11021 present 2) confirm global allow_cross_region_fallback=false 3) watch routing_fallback_count, routing_5xx_rate, per-org misroute counts 4) for orgs with >1k misroutes, apply per-tenant variant_override to pin m-prod until full validator patch.

opsbot: action log: per-tenant override applied for org-314 (override id ov-11022).

cs-lead: CS update: org-314 wants a post-incident summary + tokenized logs. Security checked sample logs; no secrets.

eng-rt: note: follow-up engineering tasks: 1) ensure validator fails fast on unknown/deprecated keys, 2) add migration tool to convert `default_variant` -> `variant_default` for legacy configs, 3) add integration test simulating cross-region fallback with pinned variants.

maya: agreed. also add a healthcheck that asserts no routes to known deprecated variants.

li: monitoring: fallback_count down to normal in last 9 mins, 5xx rate reduced. However we observed ~6k affected completions; needs accuracy/regression check vs golden set.

maya: scheduling postmortem: lead maya, reviewers: li, eng-rt, cs-lead. Meeting 2026-03-17 14:00 UTC. Include timeline, test gaps, rollout checklist, and customer comms draft.

srebot: incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Please follow up with postmortem.

li: final note: after validator patch, we should also default to explicit deny for deprecated variants at router level to prevent any accidental routing. I'll open ticket in bugs: RT-4921.

opsbot: incident closed to monitoring state at 08:58Z.
